basis: X east, Y north, Z up, metres; independent school-02 aerial fixes cross-wing ground face around Y46.4 (observed two wall feet 46.33 and 46.89 and nearby central path 45.61–45.91). Count alternatives are tested subject to an outdoor camera at Y≥13m and a common longitudinal bay pitch.
limitations: Eight aperture axes on each side are identified from the northward school photograph, including a distant end and near image edge. The first two southern piers are separately measured looking in the reverse direction in the METROMOD exposure. Eleven per complete side is the best joint equal-pitch geometric count; it is not a single unoccluded photographic count.
Statue and people obstruct the centre and vegetation obscures far lower ends. Pavilion and roof measurements taken on plane Y46.4 do not establish roof overhang depth.
The original short-garden camera would have seen the clock gate within its view cone. Its signed numerical result is preserved beside this outdoor solution.
